ground_truth: exact top-100 from datasets/sift-128-euclidean.hdf5 'neighbors', first 1000 queries
partitioning: seeded random even split (seed 20261101), 10 x 100000; no clustering, no replication

throughput_comparison_at_recall.note: both arms use the same shared 16-thread pool

hazard_found: hnswlib clamps efSearch to max(ef, k); with global k=100 the ef50 and ef100 single-graph settings are identical (1819.094 distance calls each), so 'search top-100 with ef=50' is not a real configuration
limits: 1M scale only, per user request; not a 100M measurement
single-threaded builds; build time is excluded from query latency
latency arms run one query at a time; partition_parallel deliberately spends 10 cores per query
random even split cannot be pruned for a global top-k query, so it is the least favourable split for partitioning
recall is macro over 1000 queries against exact top-100; no filtered recalls
